lines.text: The east gate stays shut because the LORD entered through it, and only the prince may eat there.
By the north gate Ezekiel sees the LORD's glory filling the temple and falls facedown.
God rebukes Israel for letting uncircumcised foreigners into His sanctuary and offering His food, the fat and the wine.
The Levites who wandered after idols may not serve as priests, but God appoints them over the temple's work.
The Levitical priests descended from Eli kept charge of the sanctuary when Israel strayed, and alone may approach God's table.
